skill.summary: Refine academic writing for computer science research papers targeting top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, CVPR, WWW, KDD, SIGIR, CIKM, and similar). Use this skill whenever a user asks to improve, polish, refine, edit, or proofread academic or research writing — including paper drafts, abstracts, introductions, related work sections, methodology descriptions, experiment write-ups, or conclusion sections. Also trigger when users paste LaTeX content and ask for writing help, mention "camera-ready", "rebuttal", "paper revision", or reference any academic venue or conference. This skill handles both full paper refinement and section-by-section editing.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "academic-writing-refiner" skill for polishing computer science research papers targeting top-tier venues.
- Refines abstracts, introductions, related work, methodology, experiments, conclusions, and supports both section and full-paper editing.
- Handles LaTeX content with careful preservation of formatting, citations, and mathematical environments.
- Applies section-specific conventions and systematic sentence-level improvements for clarity, precision, and conciseness.
- Provides clear output: refined text, marginal change notes, and flags unfixable issues.
